name: Baked BBQ Salmon with Cajun-Spiced Broccoli, Bell Pepper & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, pat salmon dry with paper towels. Place on a baking sheet pan and spread barbecue sauce over top.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
⅓ cup barbecue sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; halve crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Place bell pepper and broccoli on another baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle veggies with oil, then sprinkle with Cajun seasoning and salt. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Cajun seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until veggies are fork-tender and salmon is cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide rice, salmon, and veggies between plates. Enjoy!
